**Batch 98 is authored.** I added nine carriers, two YAML-only pages, the manifest, proof contracts, coverage and source evidence, cross-batch dependency records, and batch notes. See the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-98.notes.md) and [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-98.pages.json).

Five items are recorded `ready`. Four remain `escalated`: the Property P SU(2) lemma, Property P theorem, S³-filling slope lemma, and Gordon–Luecke theorem. Their unresolved dependency is the local gauge-theory proof: holonomy perturbations and reducible-locus analysis, long-neck ASD compactness and gluing, and the symplectic/Donaldson nonvanishing bridge. The Khovanov page prerequisite is preserved and owner-escalated because its relevant batch 97 items have `proof: not-supplied`.

Scoped checks passed: proof contracts (9/9), proof layout (9 items, 22 steps), precheck (7 proof-bearing items), rendercheck (11 files), and source fetch (9/9). The batch 98 cross-batch ledger has no missing direct edges.

The run-wide gates remain open due to 62 empty scaffold inventories, six dependency-level mismatches in batch 105, and the unrelated batch cycle `67 → 75 → 67`. The G-L carrier received a final proof-detail clarification after its escalation record; I left that owner-controlled record unchanged.
